content: Look at the character of the mother before you propose marriage to the daughter.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Madar-ra bebin, dokhtar-ra begir (مادر را ببین، دختر را بگیر) — Persian Folk Adage
explanation: Infatuation fixates on youthful charm, temporary beauty, and smooth words. But generational patterns, emotional maturity, and the deep habits of domestic peace are passed down through living lineage. Look at the deep roots before judging the flower.
practicalInsight: Look beyond surface appearances and charm when choosing partners, collaborators, or friends today.
reflectionPrompt: Are you evaluating the people you invite into your life based on surface glamour or deep character roots?
